items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: Paul, could you, uh, think of anything, you know, other types of jobs that the, the Straws would play?

ctx.x: Well, what do you play at other than Bruno's? What other places?

Well, uh, we make, uh, make a few, uh, fraternity house dances, uh, different luncheons. A little of everything, you know, the regular run of the mill jobs. Of course, nothing, uh, you know, another nightclub, but, uh, just enough to keep our hand in, you know, just to, just to keep busy. Paul, could you, uh, think of anything, you know, other types of jobs that the, the Straws would play? Uh, patio parties, things like that? For dancing at all?
They do, yeah. Well, they play a lot of dances.
